verdict.rationale: Word-level timestamps are a fair question for a speech-to-text API, so the axis applies. However, no item in the evidence pack mentions per-word timing, start/end times or word offsets. The diarization, realtime and batch items describe adjacent transcription features and do not show that words map to their position in the recording.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get word-level timestamps so every word maps to its position in the recording
